question: Which states of India have the Nallamala range of forests?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Andhra Pradesh- Telangana.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Nallamala range of forests lies in **Andhra Pradesh-Telangana, it is a part of Eastern Ghats.**
 
• It is one of the **largest undisturbed stretches of forest in South India**.
 
• It is spread over **5 districts, namely Kurnool, Guntur, Kadapa, Mahabubnagar and Prakasam.**
 
• It lies in the** south of the Krishna River, the hills run north to south, parallel to the Coromandel Coast on the Bay of Bengal**.
